title: Veterans Pension Net Worth Redetermination After One-Time VA Payments
content:
# Net worth on the award — Veterans Pension redetermination

When a retroactive compensation release reaches a Veterans Pension recipient after his compensation award has ended, VA redetermines the net worth on the award: the assets last determined, adjusted for what has been deposited since, plus annual income, rounded to the cent.

**Posting of a compensation release.** When a compensation release is paid to a pensioner, its gross amount is posted to the net worth on the award at once and stays there until net worth is redetermined.

**Declaration on file.** Net worth is not redetermined until the award carries the veteran's own declaration of the one-time VA payments deposited to him, dated on the date of the most recent compensation release. So long as the award carries no such declaration dated on that date, the net worth on the award is not redetermined.

**Countable income on the award.** Net worth is redetermined only after the countable income on the award reflects the recurring income on file as of the redetermination.

## Recording tool: `update_net_worth_02de4f94`

**Capability.** It sets the net worth recorded on a veteran's Veterans Pension award to a redetermined figure. One call replaces the award's net worth figure with the value given; no other figure, status or entry on the award changes and no payment is made.

**Invocation.** The agent unlocks `update_net_worth_02de4f94` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `pension_award_id` — the reference number of the Veterans Pension award, as shown by the pension award lookup for this veteran; an identifier.
- `net_worth` — the redetermined net worth, in USD, a decimal number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.

**Return.** On success, one sentence of the form "Net worth on award <award reference> set to <amount> USD." with the amount shown to 2 decimal places. Receiving this sentence means the award now carries that figure; the new net worth can be read back on the award. The tool defines no other outcome.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* a redetermined net worth of 48211.204 is passed as `net_worth` 48211.20.
